name: José Carlos Mariátegui
shortBio: Peruvian Marxist philosopher ("El Amauta") who rejected Eurocentric historical determinism to root Indo-American socialism in Andean Indigenous communalism (the ayllu).
centralQuestion: How must historical materialism be transformed in the Andes when Indigenous communal land tenure, rather than European industrialism, anchors liberation?

keyWorks.title: Seven Interpretive Essays on Peruvian Reality
keyWorks.description: Foundational Latin American Marxist synthesis connecting the Indigenous land question, colonial feudalism, and Indo-American socialism.
